'''Sandy Wible Inexpensive Tournament Winning Deck!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Sandy Wible]]
* '''Published:''' December 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Jungle]]
* '''Strategy:''' Inexpensive Tournament Winning Deck!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC Inexpensive Tournament Winning Deck!.txt |Download]]
